items.question: What is an AI video agent?
items.answer: An AI video agent plans, generates, and helps you refine short video clips from text, images, and audio — not just a single text-to-video button.

items.question: How is Lovart different from a standalone video generator?
items.answer: Lovart combines multimodal generation with ChatCanvas editing, Brand Kit, and campaign context so video stays on-brand across channels.

items.question: Do I need a powerful GPU?
items.answer: No. Rendering runs in Lovart’s cloud. You need a modern browser and a clear brief.

items.question: Can I use clips commercially?
items.answer: Paid plans include commercial usage rights for assets you create on Lovart. Check your plan for details.

items.question: Which aspect ratios are supported?
items.answer: Common ratios include 16:9 (YouTube), 9:16 (TikTok/Reels), and 1:1 (feeds). Specify ratio in your prompt.

items.question: Does Lovart support image-to-video?
items.answer: Yes. Upload reference stills or product shots and describe motion — ideal for ecommerce and brand films.

items.question: Can marketing teams run A/B variants?
items.answer: Yes. Generate multiple hooks or camera paths from one master brief and compare performance.

items.question: How fast are drafts?
items.answer: Most short clips draft in seconds to a minute depending on length and queue — then you iterate on canvas.

items.question: Is this the same as Seedance?
items.answer: Lovart orchestrates Seedance-class models inside an agent workflow with editing, brand, and export — not a separate tool tab.
